name: Evercraft Web Agent / Fetch & Browser
problem: An AI assistant or agent needs public web fetch/extraction, live-web discovery, browser automation, or user-authorized authenticated browsing without depending on a third-party browser-agent provider.
use_when: fetch a webpage for my AI agent
read a URL for my AI agent
live web API for an AI agent
web search API for an AI agent
give my AI live web access
inputs: Public URL, search/navigation intent, or browser task. Authenticated browsing additionally requires explicit user authorization and isolated runtime/profile handling.
outputs: Current capability state and protocol surfaces; public fetch/extraction where production-verified; later search/browser execution only when their independent runtime gates pass.
pricing: No public machine price is advertised until runtime metering and production verification are complete.
confirmation: Public capability discovery is read-only. Authenticated browsing requires explicit user authorization. Payment must never expand browser permissions or credential access.
payment_authority: No public machine checkout is advertised for Evercraft Web yet.
invocation_status: LIVE specialist discovery through the central MCP tool discover_web_capability. Evercraft Fetch is implemented and build-passed but remains external-canary gated; web search and owned browser execution remain held pending runtime activation, pairing/isolation and production receipts.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
